How We Work

Severe weather can leave behind dangerous debris, contamination, and unsafe conditions. At Oklahoma Hazmat & Remediations (OHR), our disaster response team steps in to quickly restore safety and order after storms, floods, tornadoes, and other natural disasters.

We assess affected areas, remove hazardous materials, and clear debris to make properties safe for residents, employees, and the community. Using specialized equipment and proven cleanup methods, we manage both small and large-scale recovery projects efficiently and thoroughly.

From the initial response to full site cleanup and sanitation, OHR coordinates every step of the process to help communities get back on their feet. Our team works systematically to reduce hazards, restore usability, and support recovery efforts so life and operations can return to normal as quickly as possible.
